## Architecture Overview

The `Containers` field in `corev1.PodSpec` is `[]Container`. Changing to a named type `ContainerList` breaks all code using `len()`, `range`, direct index access `[i]`, and `append()` on `pod.Spec.Containers`.

## Detailed Analysis

### ArgoCD

- **`controller/cache/info.go`** (lines 345-411) — `len(pod.Spec.Containers)`, `range pod.Spec.Containers`, `range pod.Spec.InitContainers`, `pod.Spec.InitContainers[i]` direct indexing.
- **`server/application/terminal.go`** (line 218) — `range pod.Spec.Containers` to find requested container for terminal session.

### Cert-Manager

- **`pkg/issuer/acme/http/pod.go`** (lines 205, 311) — `Containers: []corev1.Container{...}` literal construction, `&pod.Spec.Containers[0]` direct index access.

### Prometheus

- **`discovery/kubernetes/pod.go`** (lines 298-300) — `append(pod.Spec.Containers, pod.Spec.InitContainers...)`, `len(pod.Spec.Containers)` for init container detection.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/endpoints.go`** (lines 406-459) — Same `append()` and `len()` pattern for container concatenation.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/endpointslice.go`** — Similar container handling as endpoints.go.

### OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib

- **`receiver/k8sclusterreceiver/internal/pod/pods.go`** (lines 51-90) — `range pod.Spec.Containers` with indexing for metrics.
- **`processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/client.go`** (lines 1027-1120) — `append(pod.Spec.Containers, pod.Spec.InitContainers...)` combining containers.
- **`extension/observer/k8sobserver/pod_endpoint.go`** (lines 44-77) — `range pod.Spec.Containers` and `range container.Ports`.

## Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| argo-cd | controller/cache/info.go | len(), range, direct index on Containers |
| argo-cd | server/application/terminal.go | range pod.Spec.Containers |
| cert-manager | pkg/issuer/acme/http/pod.go | []Container literal and Containers[0] indexing |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/pod.go | append(Containers, InitContainers...) and len() |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/endpoints.go | append() and len() for container concatenation |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/endpointslice.go | Similar container handling |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/k8sclusterreceiver/internal/pod/pods.go | range with indexing for metrics |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/client.go | append(Containers, InitContainers...) |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | extension/observer/k8sobserver/pod_endpoint.go | range Containers and Ports |
